name: Morgana
source:
The victim of unimaginable torture at the hands of the lord.

She prefers to keep her face hidden so people can’t see the strange marks that cover it.

Morgana is a doggedly aloof young girl who rarely acts her age. 

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1053/]MangaGamer[/url]]
